invariants.rationale: The toggle changes the checked state to its opposite, thus the checked state after toggling should differ from its prior value.
The checked value after toggle should always be the logical negation of what it was before.
If getButtonState() returns the button itself, its isChecked method matches the button's own checked status after toggle.
The checked field flips after toggle.
The core effect of the method is that the checked state is flipped from before method entry.
